# What I Saw From the Ridge

*From the highest ridge of the old quarters Hodge has seen, every dawn, flocks of birds lift off the Waystone Meadows all at once, as if something startled them. Go and look, then tell Wat, who will know a shortcut back.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Hodge](../npcs/hodge.md) |
| Level | 11 |
| After | [Heavier Than a Broom](../quests/hodge_heavier_than_a_broom.md) |

## Objectives

1. Reach where the birds lift in [The Waystone Meadows](../maps/waystone_meadows.md)
2. Defeat 30 [Ribbon Pig](../monsters/ribbon_pig.md) in [The Waystone Meadows](../maps/waystone_meadows.md)
3. Talk to [Wat](../npcs/wat.md)

## Rewards

- 300 EXP
- 220 mesos
- [Red Potion](../items/red_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +150 standing with [Hodge](../npcs/hodge.md)
